title: Avengers: Doomsday Final Trailer Released, Bringing Steve Rogers, X-Men and Fantastic Four Together
excerpt:
Marvel Studios has released the final Avengers: Doomsday trailer.
The new footage features Steve Rogers, the Fantastic Four, the X-Men and Doctor Doom.
body_md:
Marvel Studios released the final trailer for Avengers: Doomsday on November 23, 2026, giving audiences a roughly three-minute look at the enormous superhero crossover ahead of its December theatrical opening. Directed by Anthony and Joe Russo, the film is scheduled to open in the United States on December 18, with some international markets beginning screenings earlier.

The trailer opens with Steve Rogers and Peggy Carter discussing whether their son should know that his father was Captain America. Scenes of their family life are interrupted by the arrival of the Fantastic Four. Reed Richards approaches Steve, signaling that the peaceful life Rogers chose after Avengers: Endgame is about to be disrupted.

The footage connects that personal story to the wider consequences of earlier Marvel events. Images associated with time travel, the Infinity Stones and Endgame accompany Steve's reflections on decisions made to set the world right. The trailer suggests those choices have consequences, but it stops short of explaining exactly how they connect to the central conflict.

Robert Downey Jr. returns to the Marvel Cinematic Universe in a new role as Victor von Doom, also known as Doctor Doom. The preview shows the armored villain and frames him as the major threat confronting heroes from different universes. His precise plan remains largely undisclosed, despite the trailer's more extensive action footage.

The ensemble includes returning Avengers and characters from the Fantastic Four and X-Men. The new preview features Cyclops and other mutants, while familiar heroes including Thor, Bucky Barnes and Kate Bishop also appear. Chris Hemsworth, Anthony Mackie, Pedro Pascal, Florence Pugh and Sebastian Stan are among the performers in the expansive cast.

Rather than revealing the entire plot, the final trailer raises several questions. Why have the Fantastic Four approached Steve? How will heroes from different realities work together? What does Doom want from them, and how might Steve's earlier decisions affect the multiverse? The footage offers clues, but fan theories about these questions should not be mistaken for confirmed story details.

Avengers: Doomsday marks the Avengers' first new theatrical team adventure since 2019's Endgame and is positioned as a major chapter in Marvel's ongoing multiverse storyline. With the final trailer now released, the film enters its last stretch of promotion ahead of its December 18, 2026 U.S. release.
